dispositions.input_claim_or_question: R2 remains accepted; no patches, suite invocation, exposure change or index rebuild authorized
dispositions.retained_instruction: This is a narrow preparation supplement under SLP-1 and R2. No new authority or blanket public-status transition.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Nornic pinned upstream cookbook is the engine fact
dispositions.retained_instruction: Retain the reported commit/file identities as upstream documentation. Distinguish documented recognition, inspected implementation, installed binary and observed effective execution.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Source cookbook link is missing; Source skill is a condensed fork
dispositions.retained_instruction: Treat as a documentation-provenance defect to confirm in current checkout. Prefer pinned upstream reference plus local deltas, not a fabricated local full cookbook.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: SimpleMatchLimitFastPath conflicts with tenant WHERE
dispositions.retained_instruction: Authorize and scope first, then observe the effective route. A slower valid route may pass. Never drop isolation to earn a fast-path name.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Literal traversal bound is a Source fork delta
dispositions.retained_instruction: Keep the literal-bound rule without inventing an eighth upstream list item. Select from trusted bounded templates; parameterize data values.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: OR/function/optional-filter rewrites and plan cache rules
dispositions.retained_instruction: Prove semantic equivalence including duplicates, nulls, ordering and scope. Preserve exact emitted text separately from any normalized fingerprint.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Pipeline falls back on unsupported clauses
dispositions.retained_instruction: An optimization miss is not a policy refusal. Trace the dedicated handler and enforce original authority across the dispatch.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Batch deletion with WITH LIMIT is bounded
dispositions.retained_instruction: Node count alone does not bound incident relationships, lock duration or transaction work. Keep cleanup separately authorized and degree/effect bounded.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Nornic vector disabled returns empty/WARN; lazy search blocks
dispositions.retained_instruction: Bind installed settings and returned/logged evidence. Health checks should not accidentally trigger search/warming. Empty unavailable instruments are not factual negatives.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Nornic dimensions silently skipped; string query auto-embeds
dispositions.retained_instruction: Audit eligible versus indexed vectors and query embedding identity. Equal dimension does not imply same embedding space. Prefer frozen query bytes for ANN-only comparison.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: 3.92M 1024-d Aura corpus is scalar vector-3.0 on 8GB
dispositions.retained_instruction: Bind instance, index, provider/options, valid vector population, model and actual memory before claiming live fit or recall. Separate this instance from the reported GDS suite host.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Quantization reduces vector payload, not application graph
dispositions.retained_instruction: Keep the Lucene cache distinction and measured example scope. Do not infer identical HNSW connectivity or Source sizes from nearly equal example .vex sizes.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Scalar current workload fits; none cannot run
dispositions.retained_instruction: Raw FLOAT32 payload exceeds nominal 8GB capacity; that is full-residency arithmetic, not proof of impossibility or measured thrashing. Include other indexes, filters, graph cache, heap, concurrency and rescore I/O.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: vector-3.0 has expansion 1.5 frozen until rebuild
dispositions.retained_instruction: 1.5 is a newer scalar expansion default. Release notes describe expansion preview in 2026.06 and GA in 2026.07. Do not attach that field to vector-3.0 without actual evidence.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Binary is the new default; rebuild to pick up HFQ
dispositions.retained_instruction: Keep explicit supported settings on a separately authorized rebuild, not automatic latest defaults. Verify provider-specific rescoring on target; keep active scalar unchanged during baseline measurement.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Neo4j binary and pgvector binary are the same sign function
dispositions.retained_instruction: pgvector uses raw component sign; documented Lucene binary uses centered optimized quantization and corrected/asymmetric scoring. Do not claim identical codes or ranking without actual codec proof.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Never use binary_quantize(table_col) in ORDER BY; generated column required
dispositions.retained_instruction: The matching expression index is an official pgvector pattern. Stored expression values need not be recomputed in an indexed search. Generated columns are an optional tradeoff; inspect the actual plan.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: PG ef_search must always exceed inner LIMIT; default ef_c is weaker than Neo4j
dispositions.retained_instruction: Fixed-scan capacity and iterative scans differ. Use scoped session settings, actual returned count, filters and cost. Cross-engine default numbers do not establish comparative recall.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: halfvec and bit HNSW should be the PG first cut
dispositions.retained_instruction: No PG ANN is needed for this measurement. halfvec is lossy float16, not scalar int8 and not full-FLOAT32 rerank. Preserve original vectors where required; no mandated storage conversion.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Recall@k equals exact/ANN set overlap divided by k
dispositions.retained_instruction: Freeze target universe, exact metric, unique identity, tie policy and self-exclusion. Handle fewer than k eligible objects and empty universes explicitly; preserve short-result/error rates.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Every ANN benchmark uses the same recall metric
dispositions.retained_instruction: Faiss documents both 1-recall@R and intersection. Store the definition rather than trusting a label or comparing unrelated numbers.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: One formula and common floors can qualify legal retrieval
dispositions.retained_instruction: 0.95/0.99 are proposed operating targets, not evidence of legal completeness. Separate geometric neighbor fidelity, relevant evidence coverage and task-specific acceptance.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Ground truth changes only with model/dimension/metric
dispositions.retained_instruction: Also rebind corpus membership, vector values, query bytes, filters/policy visibility, tombstones, snapshot and tie rule. ANN-only construction/beam changes on identical universe do not change exact neighbors.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Sample-corpus ground truth lies
dispositions.retained_instruction: Subset exact truth is valid for that subset, not the full corpus. Prefer fewer representative queries against the full eligible corpus before claiming scale-wide recall.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Exact ground truth requires everything in GPU memory
dispositions.retained_instruction: Exact blockwise search and top-k merge can cover the full corpus using bounded working memory. Freeze arithmetic precision and tie handling; do not claim Faiss/GPU execution occurred.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: db.retrieve can occupy the same ANN recall column as queryNodes
dispositions.retained_instruction: Evaluate vector-only fidelity before fusion. Fused hybrid output against cosine neighbors is overlap, not ANN-only quality; assess task relevance and preserve branch provenance separately.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: MRR/nDCG necessarily detect inverted exact top-k order
dispositions.retained_instruction: Binary relevance for all k exact neighbors can leave those metrics unchanged after permutation. Use specified graded gains or an exact-order statistic; retain human task relevance separately.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: HNSW, quantization, rescore and filters are separate subtractors
dispositions.retained_instruction: They interact and may change candidate and construction behavior. Use controlled ablations; dimension mismatch is an invalid representation/coverage state, not ordinary approximation loss.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Source category insertion caused about 12 points of loss
dispositions.retained_instruction: The paper supports a hypothesis and a representative-ingest test, not a Source penalty or universal default ranking. Preserve source benchmark claims at their actual review ceiling.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Cold/warm cache changes retrieval product
dispositions.retained_instruction: Measure independent latency/error and retrieval outcomes under comparable state. Do not flush/restart production to manufacture cold conditions. Record unknown cache state honestly.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Suite writes database, no need for snake_case rewrite
dispositions.retained_instruction: Update inspection evidence only: reported Cypher .write body, not client API, not live invocation. Bounded scripts search for .mutate is not universal absence.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Partial suite plus global timestamp proves mixed routing
dispositions.retained_instruction: Writer structure permits mixed metric ages if reported control flow holds. Actual routing uptake/requirements remain unbound. Timestamp cannot certify a coherent multi-metric bundle.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: DEGRADED_PARTIAL must block all routing
dispositions.retained_instruction: A PageRank-only consumer may remain valid; an all-metric consumer must prove required completeness/freshness or use an authorized fallback. Do not disable current service from preparation.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Catalog/served identity is enough to reuse quality evidence
dispositions.retained_instruction: Preserve independent implementation, index/provider, dataset, query/filter, metrics-publication and policy/evaluator identities. A stable catalog cannot freeze those dependencies.

dispositions.input_claim_or_question: Recall fixture and cookbook update establish learning
dispositions.retained_instruction: Measure a scoped procedure preventing incompatible, unscoped, stale or false-absence behavior while preserving useful successful work, then observe later use and task value.
